headline: Executive order sets rules meant to make federal agencies' civil enforcement and case decisions more open and fair to the people they regulate.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to be more open and fair when they enforce civil rules and decide cases against people or businesses. Such orders generally call for agencies to tell the public about their standards in advance and give people a fair chance to respond before penalties. No official summary was provided, so the specific requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and individuals regulated by federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may get more notice of the rules agencies enforce and more chance to respond during civil enforcement actions.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that enforce civil rules
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to follow fairness and openness requirements when they investigate, penalize, or decide cases.
